description:
Perched above the iconic shoreline of the Costa del Sol, this duplex penthouse with private pool and sea views on Marbella’s Golden Mile delivers a distinctive combination of serenity, style, and exclusivity. Located within a secure, gated community, it has been fully renovated to an exceptional standard, where timeless Mediterranean architecture meets contemporary, minimalist interiors. Every element, from the curated materials to the soft neutral tones, has been chosen to evoke calm, elegance, and a seamless connection to the sea.

The main level is thoughtfully designed for both relaxed living and effortless entertaining. A sleek, fully equipped kitchen with a central island opens to a refined dining area set beside panoramic windows. Nearby, the spacious lounge flows out to a sun-drenched terrace, ideal for alfresco dining or quiet mornings with a view. This level also hosts two beautifully appointed en-suite bedrooms, a stylish guest WC, and a discreet utility room.

The primary suite is a haven unto itself, with a bedroom that opens onto a private terrace, and a separate dressing and wellness space featuring a walk-in wardrobe, double vanity, makeup station, and a rain shower with sea views. A second terrace, complete with a freestanding outdoor bathtub, adds a layer of spa-like indulgence.

Upstairs, the penthouse reveals its most spectacular offering: a vast rooftop terrace designed for leisure. Here, a built-in barbecue, cocktail bar, sunbeds, open-air shower, and an infinity pool with in-water loungers are all oriented toward sweeping Mediterranean views. A third en-suite bedroom on this floor ensures complete privacy for guests.

Just minutes from Marbella’s golden beaches, the prestigious Puente Romano resort, and a network of scenic hiking trails that wind through the Sierra Blanca foothills, this residence is ideally positioned to enjoy the very best of the Costa del Sol. World-class dining, designer boutiques, beach clubs, and wellness experiences are all within easy reach, yet the home remains a peaceful sanctuary above it all.

This penthouse is the pinnacle of sophisticated coastal living on Marbella’s Golden Mile—an uncompromising expression of luxury, privacy, and lifestyle, destined for those who demand nothing but the exceptional.
